records.title: NANOSCALE STRUCTURES ON OPTICAL FIBER FOR SURFACE ENHANCED RAMAN SCATTERING AND METHODS RELATED THERETO
records.abstract: A nanoscale structure fabricated on a planar end facet of an optic fiber is described, to enable detection of molecules by surface-enhanced Raman scattering. The nanoscale structure may comprise an array of nanopillars. The nanoscale structure may also comprise a non periodic, or random, surface-relief structure. The nanoscale structure may be coated in a metal, comprising, for example, silver, gold, aluminum, iridium, platinum, palladium, copper, or a combination of the same. The nanoscale structure may be fabricated on a planar end facet of an optical fiber by interference lithography.

records.abstract: The invention discloses a field emission nitride light-emitting diode. A nano tapered N-type nitride, a nano tapered multi-quantum well and a nano tapered P-type nitride are produced. A copper nanowire is deposited on the tip of the nano tapered N-type nitride, the nano tapered multi-quantum well or the nano tapered P-type nitride. The field emission effect of the nano tapered tip is used to realize electroluminescence of the nanostructured nitride light-emitting diodes. The problem that producing the P-type nitride and a contact electrode is difficult for a nanostructure is solved.

records.title: Transistor with thermoelectric material layer for threshold voltage control
records.abstract: A transistor including a thermoelectric dielectric layer between a channel material and a gate electrode. The thermoelectric layer may have a crystal configuration that can be changed by applying a thermal pulse. Different crystal configurations have different polarizations, which results in different dielectric constants. The crystal configuration may be varied during operation using the heating element to convert a single device between two different threshold voltages.

records.assignee: MLC GT L L C FZ [AE]
all_assignees: MLC GT L L C FZ [AE]
records.abstract: A composite material contains: bovine serum albumin modified with neutral red; single-walled carbon nanotube inclusions; and lactate oxidase enzyme inclusions. A device for quantitatively assessing lactate content in body fluids comprises a working electrode, the surface of which is coated with the composite material according to the claimed invention. The technical result is that of increasing the upper limit of the range of detectable concentrations of lactate in body fluids to 57 mM, as well as reducing the time taken to perform a single measurement using the claimed device.

records.title: SFQ-BASED READOUT FOR SCALABLE QUANTUM PROCESSORS
records.abstract: Systems, devices and methods for SFQ-based readout in quantum computers are disclosed. A quantum processing unit includes multiple quantum elements and multiple Single Flux Quantum (SFQ) circuits. Each SFQ circuit is coupled with at least one quantum element of the multiple quantum elements and configured to measure the at least one quantum element. Each SFQ circuit of the multiple SFQ circuits includes a biased Josephson Junction configured to switch if the magnitude of a signal received from the at least one quantum element is above a predefined threshold.
